chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: Unpaid co-compositions with Dameron and an untitled tune Collins will record
summary: Dameron took the money from tunes they wrote together such as John's Idea; Collins plans to record an unnamed one himself.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yes, we did quite a few compositions, you know. Not -- and I never got a penny from any of them, you know, because he would take the money and buy shit with it, you know, this is what he -- that's the expression. And so consequently I would never get in -- I never received a money like John's Idea and many tunes that we have composed together. I don't even know the name of some of them. Actually we would sit up

and compose these tunes, and Tad would say, okay, now John, you're going to do this, that's the last I would hear. But I loved him, so, you know we were -- and he was a very talented man. Yeah. [PAUSE]

As a matter of fact, Tad and I did one tune together. I don't even know the name of it, I don't know whether it was even ever copyrighted or anything, but I am going to take a chance and do this tune and give it a name, and I'm going to record it. Now, I'm thinking of calling his brother [Caesar] to find out if he ever gave this a title or what, but actually it was my idea and we just expanded it. And I've never performed it, I've played it for many people, guitarists and they all want to perform it, but I won't allow them to do it. I want to do this, so I'm going to do this tune and I'm going to give it a name and I'm going to -- as a matter of fact I think I'm going to copyright it myself. I don't know that he has or not, but this is the way he did things, you know. And very, very pretty thing, and it's made to order for guitar. And Jimmy Jones is supposed to come over today and we're going to map this whole thing out.
Yes, yes. I'm going to do it. I've gotta. So any way, Jimmy's going to do some writing for me, as a matter of fact I'm thinking either he'll play on some of
these sides. But any way, I'm going to do some of Tad's things also.
